title: Battle of Hampton Roads
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Hampton Roads", at revision 1380472818, opens: "The Battle of Hampton Roads, also referred to as the Battle of the Monitor and Merrimack or the Battle of Ironclads, was a naval battle during the American Civil War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q868481, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1862 pivotal battle in the history of naval warfare". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
